title: Deer wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- antlers -->
  <path d='M36 30 L28 18 L22 20 L30 28 M36 30 L34 15 L40 16 L38 30' fill='none' stroke='#d9a066' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M64 30 L72 18 L78 20 L70 28 M64 30 L66 15 L60 16 L62 30' fill='none' stroke='#d9a066' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='40' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#c98b52' transform='rotate(-20 28 40)'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='40' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#c98b52' transform='rotate(20 72 40)'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='24' ry='22' fill='#e8b57a'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='14' ry='11' fill='#f6d3a4'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='45' r='4' fill='#3a2412'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='45' r='4' fill='#3a2412'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='44' r='1.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='44' r='1.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='57' rx='6' ry='4.5' fill='#4a2c17'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44 64 Q50 69 56 64' fill='none' stroke='#8a5a34' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <path d='M34 26 L50 2 L66 26 Z' fill='#ff4d8d'/>
  <path d='M37 22 L63 22' stroke='#ffd93b' stroke-width='3'/>
  <path d='M41 15 L59 15' stroke='#4dc9ff' stroke-width='3'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='3' r='4' fill='#ffd93b'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='55' r='4' fill='#ff8fab' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='55' r='4' fill='#ff8fab' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
